MOZ.note: The e-SNGD is an internal document-handling system for state institutions; no service for citizens or businesses is stated.

facts.fact: Mozambique's National Institute of Electronic Government (INAGE, IP) and CEDIMO staff form the team responsible for developing and implementing the e-SNGD document-management system used by state institutions, and INAGE trained 47 provincial state staff in Nampula on it on 2-6 June 2025.

MOZ.note: No tax or fee payment is mentioned.
No tax filing or tax system is mentioned.
